work.title: Work
work.intro: Four projects on GitHub, with the code open.

items.name: SENTINELX
items.line: Attack surface management and vulnerability assessment platform, for authorized use. Python, FastAPI and React.

items.name: Websites and landing pages
items.line: Pet shop, car window film, Beco do Cau, an IT school and a calculator. HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

items.title: E2E automation
items.text: Playwright with Page Object, fixtures and centralized data, on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.

items.title: Manual and exploratory testing
items.text: Test cases, regression and exploratory sessions. Every bug comes with steps to reproduce and evidence.

items.title: API testing
items.text: Playwright and Postman, contracts validated with Ajv, and authentication boundaries.

items.title: Data and SQL
items.text: SQL queries to check that the data matches what the screen shows.

items.title: AI applied to testing
items.text: Playwright MCP to explore the application and AI to help write test cases, always reviewed by me.

path.title: Background
path.intro: An electrician learns early that the fault is rarely where it shows up. That habit of diagnosing before touching anything is what I bring to software testing.

entries.title: QA engineer
